_comment: v3.66.1223 row-217 battery. Row 217 NAMES its five mutants -- deadline removal, budget reset, skipped settlement, exception replacement, and UNKNOWN-to-refusal laundering -- so this spec is a transcription of the acceptance criteria rather than a guess at them. Two of the catchers did not exist when the row was first satisfied: checking only the FIRST slice cannot distinguish one shared total from five independent timeouts, and nothing asserted that a post-effect bound reports RETAINED/UNKNOWN instead of a removal. The battery is why they exist.
subject: v3.66.1223 -- every bd-jobs remote stage waits under one shared bound
